scoring_justification: Checker recomputes densification threshold from volume-unloading curves and refits the critical-state line model from agent's raw points, then compares to paper-reported parameters.

outputs.description: Volumetric loading-unloading data for multiple cycles. The verifier recomputes the residual volume change after unloading, determines the densification threshold, and compares it to the hidden paper gold.

Critical state data points. The verifier fits a two-branch model (linear tensile, power-law compressive) to these points, extracts the critical-state line parameters, solves the rank-2 envelope equations for the relaxed critical-state line parameters (r, s, p_min, p_max), and compares all parameters against the hidden paper gold.

output_contract.notes: All files must be placed under /app/outputs. The verifier works exclusively from the submitted artifacts.

steps.description: Compute irreversible densification threshold as lowest maximum pressure p_max where residual volume change > resid_tol. Compare to expected ~8 GPa.
Fit critical state line (tensile linear, compressive power-law) to data points and extract parameters p1, qt, pt, B, beta. Score each parameter deviation.
